# Southern Downs 4x4 (SD4x4)

> Locally owned 4WD accessories specialist in Warwick, Queensland. Warwick's local ARB 4x4 Accessories stockist and a premium KickAss 12V installer. Supplies and professionally fits 4WD accessories, 12V systems and complete vehicle fit-outs in its own workshop. Not a mechanical workshop; no online store.

## Business details

- Name: Southern Downs 4x4 (also "SD4x4")
- Address: 90 Ogilvie Road, Warwick QLD 4370, Australia (opposite Black Toyota)
- Phone: 07 4548 9580 (+61 7 4548 9580)
- Email: sales@sd4x4.au
- Website: https://sd4x4.com.au
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=61556441114252
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/southerndowns4x4/
- Service area: Warwick and the Southern Downs region, Queensland (Stanthorpe, Killarney, Allora, Clifton, Inglewood, Toowoomba surrounds)
- Hours: contact the shop to confirm

## What we do

Plan, supply and fit 4WD accessories and complete vehicle set-ups for touring, towing, farm, trade, fleet and recreational 4WDs, including SXS / side-by-side buggies.

Capabilities: 12V systems and dual battery systems, solar, electrical work, bull bars and vehicle protection, Old Man Emu suspension, GVM upgrades, canopies, trays (including MITS Alloy), drawers and storage, roof racks, driving lights and work lights, winches and recovery gear, air compressors, exhausts, UHF radios, tow setups, wheels and tyres, wheel alignments and balancing, complete fit-outs, fleet solutions.

We do not offer general mechanical servicing.

## Brands

ARB (primary), KickAss (premium 12V installer), REDARC, Clearview, GME, Lightforce, STEDI, MSA 4x4, MITS Alloy, Bushranger, Hayman Reese, Rhino-Rack, Thule, Warn, Torqit, Duratray, Tuff, TRED.

## How enquiries work

1. Tell us your vehicle (make, model, year) and how you use it.
2. We recommend a set-up and give a fitted price.
3. Book it in; our own team fits everything at the Warwick workshop.

Enquiry form: https://sd4x4.com.au/book
